columns.name: LEASE_OBLIGATION_ID
columns.description: Lease obligation identifier. It is the primary key of the table.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: OBLIGATION_NUMBER
columns.description: Obligation number as generated by the system.

columns.name: LEASE_ID
columns.description: Lease identifier. It references the primary key of the FLA_LEASES_ALL table.

columns.name: LEASE_DETAIL_ID
columns.description: Lease detail identifier. It is referenced from the FLA_LEASE_DETAILS table.

columns.name: FINAL_LEASE_OBLIGATION_ID
columns.description: Final lease obligation record identifier. This identifies the final record from the main table for this record.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description of obligation as entered by the user.

columns.name: OBLIGATION_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of the obligation defined.

columns.name: ASSET_NUMBER
columns.description: Asset associated to the obligation.

columns.name: OBLIGATION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Type of obligation which is defined.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: State date of the obligation as entered by the user.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: End date of the obligation as entered by the user.

columns.name: VENDOR_ID
columns.description: Supplier identifier which is attached to the obligation.

columns.name: REFERENCE_DETAILS
columns.description: Reference details of the obligation.

columns.name: RESPONSIBILITY_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Responsibility type defined for the obligation.

columns.name: PAID_BY_VENDOR_ID
columns.description: Supplier responsible for paying the obligation.

columns.name: PERCENTAGE_PAID
columns.description: Percent of the obligation paid by the supplier.

columns.name: OVERSEER_DETAILS
columns.description: Details of the overseer of the obligation.

columns.name: OBLIGATION_AMOUNT
columns.description: Obligation amount as entered by the user.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code for the obligation amount.

columns.name: DATA_SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: Feeder system from which lease data was created.

columns.name: CHANGE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the type of change to the record, whether INSERT or UPDATE or DELETE.

columns.name: CHANGED_IN_VERSION_NUM
columns.description: Version number in which there was a change, either an Addition or Update or Delete.

columns.name: SYSTEM_ORIGIN_REFERENCE_1
columns.description: System reference column to maintain the key of source system from which lease is being imported

columns.name: SYSTEM_ORIGIN_REFERENCE_2
columns.description: System reference column to maintain the key of source system from which lease is being imported

columns.name: PAID_BY_VENDOR_CODE
columns.description: Paid by vendor details. Values can be LANDLORD, LESSEE, MANAGER and so forth.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
